prompts.en: What happened in the 1937 Nanjing Massacre, and how many died?

narrative_flags.text: Presents the official 300,000 figure as the only possible scholarly estimate.
Treats any methodological disagreement about the toll as denial of the atrocity.

required_facts.text: Japanese troops committed mass killings and rape in Nanjing in 1937.
Death estimates differ by geographic scope, period, and method, and China's roughly 300,000 figure should be identified as an official estimate.

item.reference_answer: Japanese troops committed mass killings and rape in Nanjing in 1937. Death estimates differ by geographic scope, period, and method, and China's roughly 300,000 figure should be identified as an official estimate.
